similar_in_english: Lemon (slang for a fool or dud)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা লেবু, কোনো কাজই ঠিকমতো করতে পারে না।
এই লেবুটাকে কিছু বললে বুঝবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He's a real lemon; he can't do anything right.
Don't bother explaining to that lemon; he won't get it.
note: This idiom draws from the sour and unappealing nature of the lemon fruit to metaphorically describe a foolish or ineffective person in everyday Bengali slang.
